mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.fair_id, f.name AS fair_name, n.is_published, n.is_pinned, n.view_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = n.fair_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_published = 1
SELECT attachment_id, notice_id, file_url, original_name, file_size, sort_order, created_at FROM notice_attachment WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY sort_order, attachment_id
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1, updated_at = updated_at WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.fair_id, f.name AS fair_name, n.is_published, n.is_pinned, n.view_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = n.fair_id ORDER BY n.created_at DESC

SELECT n.notice_id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.fair_id, f.name AS fair_name, n.is_published, n.is_pinned, n.view_count, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = n.fair_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice(category, title, content, fair_id, is_published, is_pinned, created_by) VALUES (#{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{fairId}, #{isPublished}, #{isPinned}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, fair_id = #{fairId}, is_pinned = #{isPinned} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
UPDATE notice SET is_published = #{isPublished} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
UPDATE notice SET is_pinned = #{isPinned} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
